cartridge_upgrades.name: Extra-Powerful (+P)
cartridge_upgrades.applies_to: suitable powder-and-shot or fixed ammunition after firearm pressure safety check
cartridge_upgrades.chat_hint_ru: Повышенное давление; для неподходящего оружия возможен штраф к Malf.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Pressure safety is weapon-specific; early TL/cheap guns and automatic action may carry Malf consequence.

cartridge_upgrades.name: Match-Grade
cartridge_upgrades.chat_hint_ru: Улучшение Acc может дать +0 при низком исходном Acc; с +P не совмещается.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: No automatic weapon; factory round is not the individually matched handload.

cartridge_upgrades.name: Personally matched handloads
cartridge_upgrades.applies_to: handloaded cased rounds matched to one specified gun, non-automatic
cartridge_upgrades.chat_hint_ru: Максимум +2 Acc; требует отдельно успешных проверок при разработке заряда.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: HT174 handloaded match is an individual-weapon match; never assume from factory match grade.

cartridge_upgrades.name: Subsonic pistol ammo
cartridge_upgrades.applies_to: fixed supersonic pistol rounds; no change for naturally subsonic rounds
cartridge_upgrades.chat_hint_ru: Пистолетный патрон: дальность ×0,8 и звук тише.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Naturally subsonic cartridges do not gain another downgrade.

cartridge_upgrades.name: Subsonic PDW/rifle ammo
cartridge_upgrades.chat_hint_ru: Винтовочный патрон: урон и дальность ×0,6; не для уже дозвуковых.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Pistol and rifle/PDW ballistic changes differ.

cartridge_upgrades.name: Silent captive-piston
cartridge_upgrades.applies_to: cased ammunition with a specially designed weapon or a documented compatible design
cartridge_upgrades.chat_hint_ru: Дорогой бесшумный патрон с удержанием пороховых газов.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Conventional chambering alone is not evidence of compatible captive-piston ammunition.

projectile_options.name: Solid/FMJ
projectile_options.applies_to: standard solid bullets and most cannon solid shot
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Базовые характеристики уже включены в атаку оружия.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Most native weapon attacks already represent solid/FMJ; no second transform.

projectile_options.name: Rifled Slug
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Сначала перевести дробь в одиночную пулю; затем накладывать допустимые опции.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Convert from buckshot; remove pellet RoF multiplier before further overlays.

projectile_options.name: Hollow-Point (HP)
projectile_options.applies_to: piercing solid bullet compatible with HP construction
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Уменьшает пробитие, увеличивает класс ранений; при низкой скорости раскрытие может быть условным.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: At low muzzle velocities HT167 allows optional failed expansion; malfunctions may apply to TL5–7 automatics.

projectile_options.name: Poison/Hollow Bullet

mechanics.follow_up: dose of selected blood or contact agent

projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Follow-Up требует подходящего наполнителя; эффект яда не вычисляется без его описания.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Follow-up poison dosage must be selected; do not produce a free second wound.

projectile_options.name: Armor-Piercing (AP)
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Урон ×0,7, бронеделитель (2); у калибров менее 20 мм ухудшается pi-класс.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Caliber modifies wound type only after candidate ammo/platform validated.

projectile_options.name: Armor-Piercing Hardcore (APHC)
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Бронеделитель (2); для малого калибра — понижение pi-класса.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: APHC is alternative projectile design, not an additional AP overlay.

projectile_options.name: Frangible
projectile_options.applies_to: kinetic solid projectile or converted rifled slug
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Разрушается о твёрдые поверхности: уменьшает пробитие, защищает от рикошетов.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Shotgun breaching load is a suitable slug subtype; avoid generic buckshot conversion.

projectile_options.name: APDS
projectile_options.applies_to: cannon and autocannon; small arms rifle/MG with proven cartridge, not pistol rounds
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Не выводить доступность для любого пистолета с тем же диаметром.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: HT167 explicitly prohibits pistol calibers; even rifle/SMG size does not prove suitable design.

projectile_options.name: APFSDS
projectile_options.applies_to: tank guns; suitable autocannon and some anti-materiel rifles at TL8
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Длинный оперённый подкалиберный снаряд: только подтверждённые платформы.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Special AMR examples are TL8; tank weapon family alone does not prove a sabot load.

projectile_options.name: Baton
projectile_options.applies_to: shotgun and grenade launchers with supported caliber
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Нелетальный замысел не означает невозможности тяжёлой травмы.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Shotgun starting values must be from the rifled slug, not buckshot.

projectile_options.name: Beanbag
projectile_options.applies_to: suitable shotguns, launcher rounds, selected revolvers
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Прицельность становится Acc 0, а не Acc-1.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Revolver class is possible only for documented designs; shotgun values start at slug.

projectile_options.name: SAPFSDS
projectile_options.applies_to: rifle and special flechette weapons, not generic cannon
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Одиночная дротиковая пуля: слабое ранение, высокий пробой.

eligibility_v1.source_rule_note: Explicitly small-arms fin-stabilized type, not general tank APFSDS.

projectile_options.name: Underwater Dart (UD)
projectile_options.chat_hint_ru: Подводная дальность по особому множителю ×25 вместо обычного; нельзя применять к любой винтовке.
